newsitem.title: USA: FGIC says Landau to head muni business development.
newsitem.headline: FGIC says Landau to head muni business development.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co, a unit of GE Capital Services, said Monday it hired Laurence Landau as leader of municipal new business development.
Landau was formerly vice president of marketing at Dow Jones Telerate Inc, a unit of Dow Jones & Co Inc.

Ann Stern, FGIC's chairman, president and chief executive officer, said in a statement announcing the move that Landau will help FGIC "in broadening the scope of our efforts to develop new products and services well beyond bond insurance."
GE Capital is a wholly-owned subsidiary of General Electric Co.
